title: VDP Policy Artifact
description: Canonical form of a compiled policy phi. SPEC.md section 2.4. This is the object whose canonical JSON serialization (sort_keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) is SHA-256'd to produce policy_hash.

version.description: AST shape version. 2 denotes the shape defined in SPEC.md section 2.3 (spec revision vdp-spec-0.3), which added counterDecl.counting (section 2.1a). A monitor MUST refuse a version it does not recognize -- in particular MUST NOT default a missing 'counting' key rather than refusing version 1.

clauses.description: An empty policy is rejected at construction (SPEC.md section 2.3) — it authorizes nothing coherently.

counting.description: SPEC.md section 2.1a. false (default/legacy): amount-summing, a matching action contributes its amount. true: call-counting, a matching action contributes exactly 1.

per_target.description: SPEC.md section 2.1b. false (default/legacy): one global running total. true: an independent running total per target -- the bound applies to each target separately.

bound.description: Minor units (cents, watt-hours, bytes, ...). Never a float.

unit.description: Display only. MUST NOT affect any decision.

items.description: The empty string is the reserved NO_TARGET sentinel and cannot be whitelisted.
